name: Skills page renders the seeded skills and opens a preview
description: Loads /skills and confirms a seeded skill (uncovered-branch-gate, linked to the Test Quality Reviewer agent) is rendered by SkillCard, then clicks it to open the right-hand SkillPreview pane via the ?id= master-detail URL. Exercises the /skills route, its GET /skills fetch, and the SkillCard -> SkillPreview selection flow. Read-only seeded data (no model call, no mutation).

cmd: Catches branches and conditionals introduced by a diff with no covering test.
steps.label: SkillPreview shows the skill's description
